title: Inbound Carriage Tariff for Northbeam Renew Trade-In Programmes
content:
The ways a device traded under Northbeam Renew Trade-In may reach the retailer, how long a prepaid label stays usable, the handling fee charged for appraising a mailed-in device and the quote at or above which that fee is waived, the freight fee charged to collect a palletised batch, the most the retailer will cover for a device lost or damaged on the way in, and the days of notice needed to book a bulk collection are all figures of the Renew programme the agreement is written under.

| Renew programme | Ways the device may reach the retailer | Label usable for, days | Handling fee for appraising a mailed-in device, USD | Quote at or above which that handling fee is waived, USD | Freight fee to collect a palletised batch, USD | Transit cover for one device, USD | Notice needed for a bulk collection, days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Renew Instant Store Quote | in-store handover only | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Renew Mail In Appraisal | prepaid label or carrier pickup | 21 | 4.99 | 150.00 | 0.00 | 700.00 | 0 |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month | in-store handover or prepaid label | 21 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 900.00 | 0 |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month | in-store handover or prepaid label | 21 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1600.00 | 0 |
| Renew Business Asset Buyback | carrier pickup or freight collection | 14 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 145.00 | 2200.00 | 5 |
| Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement | freight collection only | 30 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 245.00 | 2500.00 | 10 |

Notes to the tariff.

1. The handling fee column is the fee for appraising a device that was mailed in, and the column beside it is the quote at or above which that fee is waived. Renew Mail In Appraisal is the only programme carrying such a fee, at 4.99 USD with a waiver at 150.00 USD.
2. The freight fee column is the fee for collecting a palletised batch, and stands only on the two business programmes, at 145.00 USD on Renew Business Asset Buyback and 245.00 USD on Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement.
3. The transit cover column is the most the retailer will cover for one device lost or damaged on the way in. It stands at 0.00 USD on Renew Instant Store Quote, where the device never travels.
4. The notice column is the days of notice a bulk collection needs, 5 days on Renew Business Asset Buyback and 10 days on Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement.
5. A prepaid label column of 0 days means the programme issues no prepaid label, the handover being made in the store.
